slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether a batch can be split across vats, but never asked whether all batches must visit the vats in the fixed order Vat 1 -> Vat 2 -> Vat 3. The sequence was volunteered by the user simulator, not elicited by a targeted agent question.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Every batch must visit all three vats in the fixed order Vat 1 -> Vat 2 -> Vat 3.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the fixed vat sequence; the user simulator volunteered it in Turn 3, and the agent then treated it as confirmed in the READY_TO_MODEL summary without a targeted confirmation question.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about fixed vat sequence remained unresolved by any targeted question.

summary: The agent asked several useful scheduling questions, but it missed the P1 hidden slot on required vat sequence and then treated the user-volunteered sequence as confirmed in READY_TO_MODEL. This makes the stopping behavior premature for a flow shop scheduling model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
